offers_products.reason: Main offering is gaming entertainment; food and rooms are ancillary, not manufactured goods or software.

offers_services.reason: Casino gaming, sports betting, hotel stays, dining and racing entertainment are services delivered to patrons.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Casino, hotel, restaurant and horse betting patrons are individual people.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Customers are individual gamblers and guests; conference and event bookings are minor.

recurring_revenue.reason: Local casino patrons visit and gamble repeatedly, though without contracts.

cyclical_demand.reason: Gambling, hotel stays and dining out are discretionary and cut in recessions.

big_ticket.reason: Individual bets, meals and hotel stays are small, frequent purchases.

people_delivered.reason: Revenue comes from casino floors, slot machines, hotels and racetracks, not mainly staff time.

large_customers.reason: Customers are individual gamblers and hotel guests, not large enterprises or government.

asset_heavy.reason: Operates many casino resorts, hotels, racetracks and gaming floors needing heavy property and equipment investment.
